title: Gamma Cahul celebrate League title
description: Gamma Cahul celebrated 2020 League title. They beat Basco Balti 69-66 in the championship game. Mihail Miseailo (183-PG-02) came up with 17 points and 10 rebounds to lead the winners. Gamma recorded a 24-16 lead after ten minutes. Basco turned things around in the next two periods to eke out a 52-50 lead at the final intermission. But Gamma used a 19-14 run in the fourth quarter to triumph in the League. Serghei Epifanov (95) netted 16 points for the champions. Vladimir Gaicean (202-C-95) answered with 19 points and 9 rebounds for Basco Balti.
